basis: The chart's title, 'Reduced Screening Referrals Across Hospitals from 2012 to 2023,' is contradicted by the visual data. The plotted line shows an overall increase from approximately 1200 referrals in 2012 to approximately 3200 referrals in 2023. The title is therefore not an authoritative classification of the pattern. The dashboard provides no routing policy or threshold, making any mapping from the title to a pathway unsupported. The only supported evidence is the visual data showing an overall increase, which maps to the growth-focused pathway under the assumption that growth-focused follow-up is intended for an overall increase.
